parent_high_open_research.motivation: existing domestic weakness variables reveal a rebound channel but do not stably distinguish rebound demand from weakness continuation

research_question: Does US-session price discovery in China-focused US-listed ETFs, observed after the prior China close and before the next China open, contain a stable China-specific state that distinguishes rebound demand from weakness continuation and can later justify a bounded direction-successor family?

hard_causality.admitted_external_window: US regular trading sessions that begin after the previous China 15:00 close and finish before the current China 09:31 open

clock_feature_definition.name: post_china_close_US_regular_session_compound_return
clock_feature_definition.for_china_day_D_with_previous_china_day_: identify SPY US regular sessions with US trading date >= P and < D; for each source symbol compound each available same-session close/open return across exactly those completed sessions
clock_feature_definition.formula: product(close_s/open_s for completed US regular sessions s between P close and D open) - 1
clock_feature_definition.multi_US_sessions: compound same-session open-to-close returns; deliberately exclude US close-to-next-open gaps from this new state so the feature measures regular-session price discovery while the existing clock model retains cumulative close-to-close shock information
clock_feature_definition.missing_source_row_when_SPY_session_exis: fail_or_mark_incomplete; never silently treat as zero

preregistered_source_representations.ashs_minus_ashr: ASHS session return minus ASHR session return; small/mid A-share relative state
preregistered_source_representations.broad_china_specific_vs_spy: 0.5 * (FXI session return + MCHI session return) - SPY session return
preregistered_source_representations.china_etf_positive_breadth: fraction of ASHS, ASHR, FXI and MCHI session returns strictly above zero

must_report: missing rows relative to SPY session calendar

phase_2_development_diagnostic.models: incumbent Median head only plus the previously rejected weakness_last_hour_piecewise replay for disagreement morphology; no new candidate model is fit
target_slices: incumbent predicted-down rows with prior last-hour weakness
required_for_each_source_representation: pooled actual-up vs actual-down mean and median within incumbent-predicted-down prior-tail-weakness rows
quartile actual-high-open share and counts in that slice
annual actual-up-minus-actual-down mean difference sign inventory for 2016-2025
OHR-04 rescued-high vs new-false-high mean/median/standardized difference
OHR-04 quartile added-up precision where sample permits

source_mechanism_admission_rule.expected_direction: larger positive China-specific offshore state should favor next-China-open high versus low
required: pooled actual-up-minus-actual-down source difference is positive in the incumbent-predicted-down prior-tail-weakness slice
annual difference is positive in at least 6 of 10 OOF years
top source quartile actual-high-open share exceeds bottom quartile
the result is financially interpretable as China-specific post-close price discovery rather than only US common-market exposure
source_mechanism_admission_rule.ohr04_rescue_vs_new_false_high: supporting diagnostic, not a hard gate because the disagreement sample is small
source_mechanism_admission_rule.if_none_admitted: retain incumbent and report information-source admission failure; do not open 2026
source_mechanism_admission_rule.if_one_or_more_admitted: freeze a separate bounded candidate family before any repeat-blackbox access

forbidden: same-morning China prices, news, futures, ETFs or FX used as predictors
provider shopping based on target results
feature thresholds selected from target outcomes
candidate model ranking in this source-admission phase
quantile, alpha, threshold or class-weight search
